name: AgentNet Public Guest Agent
description: Free, independent text requests. Send plain text for word and character counts. Set metadata.agentnetSkill to sha256 for its digest.

skills.name: Count words and characters
skills.description: Count the words and Unicode characters in text.
examples: Send the text whose words and Unicode characters you want to count.

skills.name: Calculate SHA-256
skills.description: Compute a SHA-256 digest of UTF-8 text.
examples: Send abc with request metadata agentnetSkill set to sha256.
